title: The + menu closes with Escape or a click outside, with no change
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to sales rep A.
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative field.
  2. Click the + button.
  3. Press Escape.
  4. Click the + button again.
  5. Click on an empty part of the page outside the menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The + button shows beside the field.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens below the +.

Step 3:

  • The menu closes.
  • The card still shows one "Sales Representative" field reading sales rep A.

Step 4:

  • The menu opens again.

Step 5:

  • The menu closes.
  • The card still shows one "Sales Representative" field reading sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R4: “Clicking the + opens a menu below it with one option, "Sales Representative - Parts". Clicking outside the menu or pressing Escape closes it without a change.”
